card.fluidMotionDescription: Spring-tuned transitions calibrated across three tiers
card.accessibleDescription: Focus-visible rings and ARIA roles in every part
card.themeableDescription: Swap radius, icons, and primitive at runtime
card.darkModeDescription: Tokens adapt to light and dark automatically
card.proximityHoverDescription: A magnetic highlight previews where a click lands
card.dropInRegistryDescription: Install any component with one shadcn command
card.pixelPerfectDescription: Renders your design exactly — token-driven and crisp in light and dark, at any radius
card.layoutsDescription: One compositional API — borderless by default, with separated tiles or a shared frame
card.g0: Per-card layout: stacked (media/header on top) or a horizontal row.
card.g1: Grid columns. Greater than 1 enables 2-D proximity across rows and columns.
card.g2: Borderless (dividers only) or a drawn border.
card.g3: Split into individually-shaped tiles with a gap instead of one divided block.
card.g5: Card children. Each is auto-assigned its proximity index.
card.c0: Compositional parts: CardImage, CardMedia, CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter.
card.c1: Makes the whole card a clickable target (stretched button).
card.c2: Makes the whole card a link (stretched anchor).
card.c3: Opens href in a new tab.
card.c4: Accessible name for the stretched link/button when the whole card is clickable.
card.c5: Persistent selected fill + title emphasis, on top of proximity hover. The group drops the hairline dividers around the selected card so the fill reads clean.
card.c8: Called when the dismiss button is pressed.
card.p0: Title + description grid; pins CardAction to the top-right.
card.p1: Weight-animates normal → semibold when the card is selected (proximity hover previews via the highlight, not the weight).
card.p3: Top-right slot in the header (e.g. a menu button); stays clickable above the card overlay.
card.p5: Actions row. Trailing-right in inline cards, but drops below the text (natural order) in an inline card with a CardImage; wraps under the content when stacked.
card.p6: Leading icon in a tinted 32×32 tile, or a brand logo / [logoA, logoB] tuple.
card.p7: Full-bleed image — a top banner when stacked, a square leading image when inline. Corners round only inside a framed tile (outlined, or a caller's overflow-hidden wrapper); a borderless card reads as a plain rectangle.
card.p8: Small uppercase label above the title.
card.p9: Icon + title + description row for feature lists.
card.b2: Renders the action as a link.
card.b5: Icon side. Defaults to end for external actions, else start.
card.b6: Appends an outward arrow and opens href in a new tab.
